title: Listen and choose 3.3
role: Cultural guide helping a visitor who has made a social mistake
can_do: I can express regret and embarrassment.
I can give advice to avoid a cultural mistake with a light second conditional.

items.prompt: What would help the guest avoid the mistake?
items.explanation: The speaker says: if you asked first.

items.prompt: Why does she carry a scarf?
items.explanation: The speaker says: she wore a short skirt in the church.

items.prompt: What should you do with older people?
items.explanation: The speaker says: wait for them to start.
